[LGRA.5.11] **A schema has at most 255 slots.** The
compiler **must** refuse a program in which any schema has more, with
`DS_VALIDATE_SCHEMA_TOO_MANY_SLOTS`. The limit counts every slot the schema
holds, and binds every schema the program declares or the compiler declares for
it, such as a capture fact's ([LTAC.3.5], [LCCO.5.2]). A slot's index in the
artefact is a byte, and 255 is reserved ([RDSC.4a.9.1]).
